# uzc_blockstorage_backup (Resource)

Schedules recurring backups for a UzCloud block storage volume (POST /blockstorages/{slug}/backups). There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the schedule. The create endpoint queues a job rather than returning the created backup schedule (it also has no "name" input to match on), so this resource polls the backup list for a new id until one appears.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_blockstorage_backup" "example" {
  blockstorage   = uzc_blockstorage.example.slug
  interval       = "dailyAt"
  at             = 1
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
  plan           = "backup-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `at` (Number) Hour of day the backup runs at (e.g. 1 for 1am), per `interval`.
- `blockstorage` (String) Slug of the uzc_blockstorage volume to back up.
- `interval` (String) e.g. "dailyAt".
- `plan` (String) Plan slug, usually based on GB usage.

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Defaults to "hourly": snapshots and backups are billed by usage, the API rejects monthly and yearly cycles for them, and the provider-level `billing_cycle` default is therefore not used.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Falls back to the provider's `cloud_provider` default when unset.
- `immediate` (Boolean) Whether to also run the first backup immediately.
- `is_vm_password_required` (Boolean) Whether a password is required to access the backed-up virtual machine.
- `is_vm_ssh_required` (Boolean) Whether SSH access is required for the backed-up virtual machine.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_blockstorage_backup.example <blockstorage-backup-slug>
```
